title: Upstream IdPs behind the AS: Google (OIDC) and GitHub (plain OAuth 2.0, no id_token)
description: The federation half. Google is OIDC: verify the id_token, require email_verified. GitHub is NOT an OIDC provider -- plain OAuth 2.0 with no id_token -- so the identity has to be read by calling the API as the user, and /user/emails gives verification. The AS normalises both into one local subject. Each IdP's failure modes (a revoked grant, a deleted account, a changed email) have to leave the local account working, since the MIMI URI is the identity and the IdP link is not.
